verdict.summary_en: Korean/English delivery note DN-260904-745 dated 2026.09.04 from Hwaseong Memory Co., Ltd. to Soony Distribution Center Hamburg. It covers two lines of CMP-GAM-002 Game Card 64 GB – Grand Heist 5: 13 000 PCS in 2 boxes and 11 000 PCS in 22 boxes. That is 24,000 PCS in 24 boxes, 360 kg total, shipped by Nordhav Shipping A/S. It lists POs 4500318705 and 4500318707. It has no corrections or strike-throughs. A receiver signature 'Yilmaz D.' is present, and a red supplier stamp sits over the table.
red_flags: Two PO numbers (4500318705, 4500318707) are listed in the header, but the lines do not say which PO each quantity belongs to.
The same part number CMP-GAM-002 appears on both lines with different box counts (2 boxes for 13 000 PCS, 22 boxes for 11 000 PCS). No explanation is given.
The receiver signature has no receiving date, and the stamp carries no date.
observations: The red round stamp overlaps the unit and box columns at the lower right of the table. It partly covers the 'PCS' text in row 1 and the 단위 header, and it is close to the box counts '2' and '22'. These remain readable.
The signature 'Yilmaz D.' is handwritten in dark blue ink on the 인수자 line.
A barcode is printed at the top right. No prices are shown.
The document is slightly skewed (rotated), which does not affect legibility.
